tests.why: new test: menu items drop new-run when the setting is off; hiddenActions is new in src/ui/actions.ts

tests.why: browser test of palette, help, New session dialog and the API refusal on a host started without the setting

tests.why: new test: with runs on, health reports it and POST /api/runs reaches the manager (git-repo error, not 403)

tests.name: action registry > leaves New run out of the menu bar unless the host runs with AMC_RUNS=1
tests.why: second assertion: with the setting on every action including new-run is listed

tests.name: lists New run in the palette, help and New session when the host runs with AMC_RUNS=1

tests.name: hides New run everywhere and refuses to start a run when the host runs without AMC_RUNS=1

tests.name: a task whose check passes waits for the owner, and Merge brings it into the checkout's current branch
tests.why: changed assertion: a brief without tries starts with maxTries 2

tests.why: changed assertion: retry prompt says try 2 of 2 under the new default

tests.name: a brief takes 1 to 5 tries and refuses 0 or 6
tests.why: new test of the 1..5 range and 0/6 refusal, behaviour the base already had; title quotes the MUST's range and cases
